sitrep.d: The full board, cold start. Spoken, it flushes the [[ready-rack|Ready Rack]] and delivers blocks 0 to VII in fixed order. From 9/10 it also lands as this page.

oscar-mike.d: Park the current work in oscar-mike/ and move on. [[charlie-mike|Charlie Mike]] resumes a card; [[rtb|RTB]] later sends the keepers home and clears the folder. Every park ends with the OUT block.

sweep.d: Retired 9/10, replaced by [[rtb|RTB]]. Was: promote the parked keepers to their real homes and clear oscar-mike/.

how-copy.d: End of orders. The reply opens Good copy plus a readback, then executes. Solid copy means nothing to add. Bad copy on an item means one question.

boresight.d: The understanding check before delivery: readback, the read, clarifying questions only. Nothing builds until you clear it. Boresight in on X aims it at one item.

bolo.d: "BOLO that" / "put that down": a tasking captured in BOLO.md the turn it is spoken. Be On the Lookout, named for the bolas: thrown on sighting, wraps, holds. The board noun is the watchlist itself.

pmcs.d: Preventive Maintenance Checks and Services. The operator is equipment: body, medical, life admin. Never mixed with projects.

ivory-tower.d: Academic mode: published literature only, every claim cited inline, established versus contested marked.

break-break.d: Open a detour; the main thread parks where it stands. [[buttonhook|Buttonhook back]] closes it.

buttonhook.d: Close the detour and return to the parked thread unprompted, restating where we were.

run-the-darkroom.d: Launch [[darkroom|DARKROOM]] in the background, no questions. The garbles black room and dark room read the same.

belay.d: Cancel the preceding order. Confirmed in three words or fewer; the record keeps the belay line, not the order.

endex.d: Close the session: write the cache note, update STATE.md, append the journal. Autosave commits on stop.

ready-rack.d: _CACHE/. Session notes staged for the next sit rep. Flushed into the [[magazine|Magazine]] on every board; an empty Rack proves the handoff completed.

magazine.d: _LOG/. Deep storage for flushed session notes. Append-only; nothing is deleted, it is stowed.

fresh-ten.d: Block I: the ten projects touched most recently, newest first, each with its last-touched date and a concrete next step.

ancients.d: Block II: the longest-untouched work in three tiers, each item with what it is waiting on.

deep-stacks.d: Block III: projects ranked by volume of thought spent, from PROJECTS.md. Volume is characters of conversation, a proxy for thinking, not value.

leverage-line.d: Block VI: the single highest-leverage next action. Provisional rename pending: the Main Effort, MCDP 1's term for the one point everything else supports.

soi.d: Signal Operating Instructions. The proword card, SOP §0. Closes every board as Block VII.

sop.d: SOP.md, the canonical home of every comms code and session protocol. On any conflict with memory, the file wins.

trunk-black.d: BLACK = Bold Venture (BVX): creative, IP, systems. Everything you make lands in one of two houses; this is the first.

trunk-orange.d: ORANGE = Ultrasin: venture, body, sexuality. The second house.

trunk-operator.d: OPERATOR = you as equipment: [[pmcs|PMCS]], tooling, readiness. Not a house; the person who runs both.

stall-pattern.d: The recurring failure: a finished design blocked on one unanswered decision, then rebuilt from scratch later. The fix is the ruling, not more structure.

d9.d: Ledger item D-9 on the [[bolo24|BOLO 24]] charter: the [[boresight]] HOLD from 9/3, converted 9/4, carrying no date. Three legal answers under the project flow: clear delivery · re-hold with a date · NO-GO. An undated hold is the [[stall-pattern|stall pattern]].

bolo24.d: The zero-budget ORANGE launch: 3D erotica stills in Blender, DARKROOM-fed, Ultrasin as the studio, a first signing with an arc. Charter in _PRIVATE/. Gated by [[d9|D-9]]; the next proposed gate is [[r9|R9]].

r9.d: Synthesis recommendation 9: thirty days on a fresh X account before any platform commit. Zero cost. Metric: follower growth against Kirenes' no-funnel rate and Variety Itsol's studio-promoted year one.

r10.d: Fill reference seats 4 to 8 with the same agent template: a disclosed-AI creator on Fanvue, a Patreon 3D still artist, a Reddit-native grower, the itsmemphishxe reference.

cam-line.d: The Lab-venture question: live cam access is Siswet's moat, and a rendered persona cannot stand in a live room. Board it as the difference between the two ORANGE plays, or rule it irrelevant.

ultra-dark.d: BOLO 27: the curation imprint under Ultrasin. A rating scale plus a written line on every post; commissioned edits as the first-dollar line. A funnel, never the asset.

block-c.d: The [[ultra-dark|ULTRA DARK]] walkthrough's third step: you mark 12 to 16 clips in [[stash|Stash]], say marked, the pull script fires, Resolve builds the 12-second blurb. Blocks A and B have been done since 9/4.

stash.d: The video library app on :9999. 15,492 scenes, 2,499 flagged as studio content, the UD pool of 2,111 five-stars. BOLO 28 made it the video twin of [[darkroom|DARKROOM]].

darkroom.d: The corpus browser on :8484. 55,841 girls-only images, verdicts, and since 9/9 the tag rail plus the TAGGING and CAPTCHA modules. Stamped 1.0 on 9/6, 1.1 on 9/9.

bolo44.d: The tag rail and zero-shot tagging in [[darkroom|DARKROOM]]. Six axes, 48 values, 16,496 judged records. [[tier2|Tier 2]] probes now make the proposals.

tier2.d: Per-axis logistic-regression probes trained on your CAPTCHA rulings. They beat zero-shot on all six axes (66 to 82 combined against 52 to 62). Retrain after each tagging session.

bolo43.d: [[l2b|L2b]] module 2: population signatures. Nine populations across the 27-cell gluteal substrate, the override construct for surgery, a three-line cell call. Seven decisions open in its §7.

l2b.d: The body-shape layer of the character system. Chain ruled 9/9: SKELETON → MUSCLE → FAT → CONDITION. Module 1 is gluteal (27 cells, 13 named types); module 2 is [[bolo43|population signatures]].

telling-profile.d: The Ten Questions of the Telling, answered for [[outliers|The Outliers]] as a [[series]]. Drafted 9/10 with 12 rulings queued. No human narrator; the Feed speaks, Tori sees.

series.d: Ruling R9 of 9/9: The Outliers is a series, not a feature and not prose. Recorded in the storyform frontmatter. It unblocked the first scene card and the first Fountain pages.

outliers.d: OVEREXITOUT / The Outliers: the flagship BLACK IP. Storyform ruled 8/24, DCUS instanced 8/26, medium ruled [[series]] 9/9, first pages 9/10. Anna still has no node.

warroom.d: The MCDP doctrine browser: MIL.01 to MIL.11 as a game encyclopedia on the [[ck3-rules|CK3 rules]]. Version 1.1 wears the [[watch-register|WATCH register]]. Name provisional; paused by you on 9/6.

watch-register.d: One grammar, two faces keyed to room light: DAY paper for the lit desk, NIGHT near-black for the dark one. Seven hues, every ratio contrast-checked against the long-watch standards. WARROOM wears it; this page moved to the creator-cases colorway on 9/10 by your ruling.

ck3-rules.d: Nineteen rules derived from Crusader Kings III's interface: concept links with nested tooltips capped at depth 3, timer or key lock, a character-sheet layout, an outliner plus an encyclopedia, one semantic color set. This page runs on them.

bolo45.d: The creator-case sweep and the manager path. Ruled 9/10: [[natasha-teen|Natasha Teen]] is the referent; everything public unless you specify; the management recon ordered. Its three files never landed; relaunched this evening.

the-take.d: The placeholder name for the lessons block on each creator case. Ruled [[ttp|TTP]] on 9/10.

creator-case.d: One file about one creator: how they started, how they run it, how they get paid. Public record only, filed beside the [[register|performer register]]. Seven exist; two more are running.

register.d: 138 names, any sex, 21 in the stable core. Lanes: performer · e-girl · creator case · Stash name. Built 9/8 from nine of your lists; widened 9/9.

nasa-girl.d: The performer you recalled by story (used to be an engineer, NASA, then did this). Two candidates were built on 9/10; you named her this evening: Rebel Rhyder. Her case is running; the candidates stay as receipts.

natasha-teen.d: Register row, lane P, starred by you 9/9. The referent for like Natasha Teen did; her case verifies whether she built an agency or roster.

explainer.d: The elementary landing-page voice you liked on 9/10: what we did last, what the plan was, what you did, in plain words. This board's right rail speaks it on every block.

modmigrate.d: _tools/modmigrate/: the 9/7 Minecraft modpack migration (Modrinth Fabric 1.21.11 to NeoForge 1.21.11). Real work with no STATE row, no BOLO, no journal. Surfaced on three boards running.

bolo37.d: The proword selection loop: five candidates, pick three ranked, ten a day, Claude's sealed pick revealed after. Name bench MINT (rec). Three spec gaps; gap 3, placement, is answered by this page.

bolo38.d: The sit rep as a front page, the CK3 save-load screen. Captured 9/6; fired 9/10 evening on your order. This page is v0.

the-box.d: The machine's servers: [[stash|Stash]] on :9999 and [[darkroom|DARKROOM]] on :8484. Both up this evening, the first time at a board since 9/4.

bolo29.d: The SFW TikTok channel: owned Fortnite skins doing the emotes, faceless, BLACK. Research banked; held on one question, the reward-versus-risk reading.

bolo35.d: The story timeline tool and its theory: sound synthesis against the conservatory score. Read delivered 9/6; four questions held.

bolo41.d: The locus system: research filed by neighborhood. Convention provisional in _0.1_BVX_LEARN/LOCI/; needs your ratification.

numbering.d: Two domains share the 03 prefix: 03_SETTING_SYSTEMS (stood up 8/25) and the empty pre-reserved 03_PLOT_SYSTEMS. One rename either way.

trash-land.d: BOLO 30: the man-made trash DMZ between the southern and northern US, mountain-range scale. Seed node written 9/6; seven rulings open, name bench recommends The Midden.

main-effort.d: MCDP 1's term: the one task everything else supports. Spoken, it names or asks for the single priority. Provisional since 8/21; the sit rep's Block VI rename rides on it. On this board it has been [[block-c|Block C]] plus [[d9|D-9]] since 9/4.

smeac.d: The Marine Corps operations order: Situation · Mission · Execution · Administration and Logistics · Command and Signal. Mission first, then how. A BOLO status page is written in this shape.

speed.d: MCDP 1: speed over time is tempo, and tempo is itself a weapon. On a page: read in ten seconds, the order on top, the story underneath. One of the three that govern the status page, with [[focus]] and [[boldness]].

focus.d: MCDP 1: the convergence of effects at the decisive time and place, which demands strict economy everywhere else. On a page: one [[main-effort|main effort]] named, everything else supporting it and kept short.

boldness.d: MCDP 1: unhesitating exploitation of uncertainty to pursue major rather than marginal results; do not strive for certainty before you act. On a page: every call carries a default that runs if you say nothing.

commanders-intent.d: The purpose behind a task, stated as task plus in order to. The why outlasts the what, so a subordinate can act without asking. The Mission paragraph of every status page carries it.

mission-tactics.d: Assign the task and the intent, leave the method to the one doing it, intervene only by exception. It is why a status page states defaults instead of asking questions.

ofm.d: The fansite-era management agency: an operations vendor running messages, traffic and posting on the creator's own account for 20 to 50 percent or more. A different business from the licensed booking agent of the studio era (10 to 15 percent).

ash.d: Riley Reid's creator-first agency, launched April 2021 because friends were paying up to 30 percent. The verified item behind the recon's creator-first list; the earlier Clubhouse Media Group line was a conflation and is corrected.

fla-468.d: Florida's talent-agency licensing statute: anyone who, for compensation, procures engagements for an artist, and artist includes a model. Running a creator's own account is not obviously procuring; booking that creator into a shoot or brand deal plainly is. An attorney question the moment a second human is booked.

management-recon.d: The sourced read on the manager path, 171 URLs: two businesses share the word agency; Fanvue is the only platform with a real agency structure; creator-first is the documented origin of the lane; reputation, not capital, is the barrier.

management-voices.d: Twenty-two first-person accounts of people who became managers, agency owners or house-builders. Nobody credible started with a roster; they started with one relationship. The commission number is the ethics map. Account control is the line.

bolo42.d: The admired-performers table, delivered 9/8 as the [[register|performer register]]; widened 9/9 to any sex; the creator-case nodes link from its rows.

rebel-rhyder.d: The [[nasa-girl|NASA girl]], named by you 9/10 evening. Her case landed the same night: an electrical engineer who worked in aerospace for two years, in her own words; NASA is Rocco Siffredi's word only. Register row added, lane P, source S.

challenge.d: The formal challenge, spoken as written in STATE.md's header. The countersign follows, first line, exact, then the board. The ritual is never explained.

out-block.d: Every reply that executes an [[oscar-mike|Oscar Mike]] or an [[endex|ENDEX]] closes with the fenced end-of-transmission block and nothing after it: OSCAR MIKE · OUT · OUT · OUT. A visible seam between what was parked and what starts next. Coded 9/6 on your order.

status-on-bolo.d: The plain-speech form of [[frago|FRAGO on N]]: "give me the status on BOLO 45" fires the same page. Dictation garble "Frango" reads as FRAGO.

recon.d: Benched 9/6: the [[boresight]] protocol aimed outside the wire (web and literature) instead of at the vault. "Napkin recon" would be the one-pass form. Waits in the [[bolo37|selection loop]].

napkin.d: Benched 9/6 as a modifier: back-of-the-napkin, one pass, rough numbers, no question loop. Spoken as a prefix: "napkin boresight", "napkin recon".

syllabus.d: Benched 9/6: "pull the syllabus on X" = the tier-one 101 textbooks of a field, [[ivory-tower|ivory tower]], one per field to start.

distill.d: Benched 9/6: make the BVX-LEARN one-sheet. The doctrine's own word: distill, don't summarize.

grammar.d: Benched 9/6: "write the grammar" = derive a system's operating language from its sources.

mint.d: Recommended name for the proword selection loop ([[bolo37|BOLO 37]]): where the house tongue gets struck, beside DARKROOM and WARROOM. Bench: BREVITY · SOI · CALLSIGN · LEXICON. Your ruling.

readyroom.d: Recommended name for the sit rep front page program: the Navy's briefing room, sibling of DARKROOM and WARROOM. Bench: OPSROOM · FRONTPAGE · THE BOARD. Your ruling.

ttp.d: Tactics, Techniques and Procedures. Section 10 of every [[creator-case|creator case]]: the one mechanic worth studying, three to five transferable tips, what does not transfer, and which venture it feeds. Named by Papi 9/10 from the Corps bench (GOUGE was the provisional header); struck alternatives THE TAKE, LESSONS LEARNED, HOT WASH.

rtb.d: Romeo Tango Bravo, return to base. The parked work goes home: every keeper in oscar-mike/ is promoted to its real file, the rest deleted, the folder cleared. Papi's own coinage 9/10; replaces the retired [[sweep|sweep]]. Third movement of the park trio with [[oscar-mike|Oscar Mike]] and [[charlie-mike|Charlie Mike]].

charlie-mike.d: Continue mission. Resume a parked card: open it, one line on where it stood, pick up at its resume order, no re-derivation. Ruled 9/10. The park trio is Oscar Mike (park), Charlie Mike (resume), [[rtb|RTB]] (return to base).

gouge.d: Navy and Marine slang for the essential distilled information. Recommended 9/10 as the name for the creator-case lessons block and used as its provisional header for a few hours; Papi ruled [[ttp|TTP]] instead. Bench only.

frago.d: Fragmentary order. RULED 9/10 ("let's move ahead on FRAGO, I like it") as the name of the BOLO status page: "FRAGO on 45" or "give me the status on BOLO 45" builds and publishes that BOLO's update — the [[smeac|five-paragraph order]] with the next action on top, governed by [[speed]], [[focus]] and [[boldness]]. A FRAGO changes only what changed; everything not mentioned stands as ordered. Retired bench: STATUS · THE 411 · OPORD.
